title: Mall World In History
content: I was wondering about documentation of Mall World through the ages. Cicero in about 50BC describes "The Method Of Loci" [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Method\_of\_loci](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Method_of_loci) Arthur Conan Doyle talks of a "Mind Palace" in the Sherlock Holmes stories. Can anyone think of others or other cultures that have this. See you at The Mall
